source_class: user orientation-controlled photograph of the complete DSI flat-flex cable laid flat and untwisted
observations: The complete cable is shown laid flat without a twist, so the two end faces can be compared in one orientation-controlled view.
On the photographed face, the left end shows the exposed contact fingers.
On the same photographed face, the right end shows the blue stiffener/backing face and no exposed contact fingers.
Therefore the exposed conductor faces are on opposite sides at the two ends of the cable.
The cable is the 15-way 1.0 mm DSI FFC used with the final DSI506/DYL0023 module.
remaining_orientation_gate: Cable type is now closed. Production host-to-module pin-1 orientation still requires identifying pin 1/contact-side at the DSI506 module receptacle and verifying the installed cable direction against the M1 top-contact SFW15R-2STE1LF host receptacle, or performing a continuity check.
required_closure_evidence: Identify DSI506 module receptacle pin 1 and its contact side/insertion direction from a clear close-up or continuity measurement.
Verify that the installed Type-B cable maps M1 host pin 1 to DSI506 module pin 1 without a cable twist.
